recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision reopens STU3 patch publication or asks for additional Identifier.system examples in the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-16675 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 correction reporting that the generated Identifier.system valueUri example in profiles-type.xml/profiles-types.xml contained prose with whitespace instead of a valid URI.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-16675 was found. The same invalid Identifier.system example was fixed through same-change-family issue FHIR-17431 in svn revision 14075, represented by git commit 2f577a81d2c0833f5bbe23b020262257b89339cc, which replaced the combined prose value in source/datatypes/identifier.xml with http://www.acme.com/identifiers/patient.
additional_context: Identifier is actively listed under source/fhir.ini [types], so source/datatypes/identifier.xml is current build-scope source. FHIR-17431 is already audited on the combined branch at df6b1487d7f70e88661147428b1cf3373f63183c. Later FHIR-22711 requested an STU3 technical correction for the same historical generated example but was resolved Not Persuasive/No Change because no STU3 technical correction release would be published.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source has Identifier.system typed as uri with example http://www.acme.com/identifiers/patient, separately preserves Identifier.value guidance for urn:ietf:rfc:3986, and does not contain the old invalid combined example.
